verdict.rationale: Stripe documents issuing refunds through the Refunds API or the Dashboard, with step-by-step Dashboard instructions. Terminal in-person payments are managed alongside online payments in the same Dashboard, so they fall under this refund flow. missing for 10: explicit evidence of partial-amount refunds, refunds initiated from the point of sale or reader, confirmation that refunds return to the original card, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
